_comment: Linux collector-side steps (tools/dev/field-guided.py, run by tools/dev/collect-linux-field-report.sh after the daemon's field run): probe steps read a state once with no person, observe steps prompt a gesture and watch a count rise in the day log or the Metrics database, attest steps take the person's y, n or s. Counts and closed codes only reach the report; the commands are fixed argv lists run without a shell. Each TODO « To confirm on Linux » point names the steps that decide it in field_todo_coverage.json.

steps.proves: The daemon's input path is open to this user: /dev/uinput is writable and at least one evdev node is readable.
The user manager starts Ergopti at login: its systemd user unit is enabled.
A polkit authentication agent runs in this session, so an administrator prompt can appear.
On GNOME or KDE Wayland the compositor focus reporter answered: the day log says Listening for GNOME Shell or KWin focus reports.

steps.gesture: Under X11 with Metrics on: move a window, resize it, maximise it and back, then move it to another monitor (one monitor: press s).
steps.proves: Each window gesture adds its events_window_topo row (move, resize, state change, monitor change) from the libxcb and RandR reads.

steps.gesture: Unplug the network (or switch Wi-Fi off), wait 40 s, plug it back and wait 40 s. Bring no VPN up during this step.
steps.proves: Unplugging the network and plugging it back adds events_network internet_down and internet_up rows, and no vpn_connected row while no tunnel came up.

steps.gesture: Bring a WireGuard tunnel up (wg-quick up <name>), wait 30 s, bring it down and wait 30 s (press s if none is configured).
steps.proves: A WireGuard tunnel brought up then down adds events_network vpn_connected and vpn_disconnected rows.

steps.gesture: With a slow model, type until the spinner shows, then move the mouse; again, then turn the wheel; again, then touch the touchpad; again, then press F5.
steps.proves: Pointer activity and a key the tooltip does not own cancel a pending prediction, one User activity line each at DEBUG.

probes.pattern: Prediction withdrawn: another native window took the focus

steps.gesture: With a slow model, type until a prediction is pending, then switch to another window (Alt+Tab or a click); repeat once.
steps.proves: Switching window withdraws a pending prediction within the focused-window poll, one line per withdrawal.

steps.gesture: With a prediction shown, press a validation digit and a navigation chord: it stays and acts.
steps.proves: The validation digits and the navigation chords keep a shown prediction and act on it.

steps.gesture: On GNOME or KDE Wayland: switch between an excluded app and another (hotstrings stop and resume), change a browser tab (the title follows), then switch the GNOME extension off (the identity becomes unknown).
steps.proves: The focused window drives the excluded-applications rules and the per-app metrics, a browser title change updates the title, and the GNOME extension off makes the identity unknown.

steps.gesture: On Wayland run the setup wizard to the end; press the magic key in an editor; unplug and replug the keyboard and press it again: it still works.
steps.proves: The wizard runs on Wayland, and the magic key grabs, injects and survives a keyboard hotplug on real evdev nodes.

steps.gesture: On the physical keyboard type fb then Space, fb then Enter, and fb with ★ at 1, 2 and 3 arrows; then make the composed layout the emulated one and type its symbols row.
steps.proves: On a physical keyboard the item 50 cascade types the cascade_vectors texts and the composed layout types its symbols.

steps.gesture: On KDE Plasma (Wayland) with Bépo: choose the emulated layout, log out and in, type letters and digits; then switch to the digits-first build: it applies without a restart.
steps.proves: On KDE the layout emulation W1 to W3 hold after one login and the digits-first build replaces the slot without a restart.

steps.gesture: Open the tap delay row and each tray dialog; restore and clear a group; use open target; press Backspace at a word start in an editor.
steps.proves: The owned GTK host shows the tap delay row and every tray dialog, group restore and clear, open target, and Backspace at a word start.

steps.gesture: Change Tap-holds > sticky delay and tap Shift then a letter (the wait follows); change CapsWord in the menu (it applies at once); one-shot Shift and CapsWord on the physical keyboard.
steps.proves: The sticky delay row changes the one-shot wait, a CapsWord menu change applies at once, and one-shot Shift and CapsWord behave on a real device.

steps.gesture: In « Raccourcis physiques », bind a physical slot (a key with no modifier) to an action that types text, save it, then press that key once in an editor (Debug log level).
steps.proves: A press of a bound physical slot under the evdev grab fires its action, one Keyboard shortcut fired line per press at DEBUG.

steps.gesture: Did the press type the action's text once, with no character of the key itself and no hotstring, tap-hold, layer or magic-key effect, and does the editor still show the slot after you reopen it?
steps.proves: The physical slot's output reaches the focused window alone and the editor keeps the saved slot.
